text.p: British engineering group BBA Group Plc said on Monday it had agreed to buy International Airmotive Holding Company for 112.8 million stg.

At completion BBA will assume International Airmotive's outstanding debt which it estimates to be around 63.4 million stg. BBA said the total investment in International Airmotive was expected to be close to 176.2 million on a debt-free basis.
BBA said the acquisition would be paid in cash out of its existing resources and expected to complete the purchase early in 1997.
"International Airmotive and BBA's existing aviation activities together offer exciting growth prospects both in the U.S. and worldwide," BBA said in a statement.

International Airmotive, which has two main subsidiaries, Dallas Airmotive Inc. and International Turbine Service, Inc., made profit before interest and tax of 7.9 million stg and pre-tax profit of 3.0 million on sales of 91.6 million for the nine-and-a-half month period to December 31 1995.
